audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) — the one field that exists to hold cooldowns held only prose.

audit.corrected: Real rank-1 cooldowns and ranges written into the field.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Do/Don't body was tradeGood or tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED), so the title promised something the body never explained.
audit.why: A duplicated body tells the reader nothing the card above it did not already say.
audit.corrected: Body rewritten to its own title against the enemy's real kit and cooldowns.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Shifting Sands for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Shifting Sands is 22s at rank 1: his shield-dash to a soldier — step up on its downtime, not before. - Arise! posts a soldier every 1.5s and Conquering Sands is 14s. - Budget your own E for emergencies and the 120s R for opportunities.

edits.before: W behind the wave, Q-drag the soldier through Azir on his last-hit, auto once through the soldier, step back — two-second trades he cannot answer without overextending.
edits.after: You both pay 70 mana a Conquering Sands and 40 a soldier, so bank Manaflow off soldier autos into the wave and spend Q only once his own sand is on its 14s.

edits.before: Standing at max soldier range admiring your poke with E on cooldown — that is the engage window every Azir player is waiting for.
edits.after: Two mirrored soldier lines clear at the same rate, so a blind crash hands his jungler a lane already pushed onto your half of the river.
